scope: Evaluator-authored new-domain/file-read composition, unseen to the native generator before this run. Not a blinded independent-family holdout or original28 case. Frozen after generic readiness guidance, before inspecting generated files.
checks: Static portable browser implementation with no backend/account/cloud/AI/network dependencies
Correct count/minimum/maximum/mean for valid finite data, one-decimal display
Exact schema and number/string/bool/range/count/byte validation with safe errors
Choosing another file replaces current state
Clear/latest-file wins during a deliberately delayed browser file read; no stale result restoration
Clean portable setup/tests and original pinned inputs retained
